typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string (),
	userName as string ()
}

source(output(
		Date as date,
		Location as string,
		Rack as string,
		DischargeAirStpt as double,
		DischargeAirTemp as double,
		RetTemp as double,
		UnitStatus as string,
		ValvePos as double,
		AuxTemp as double,
		VFDSpeed as double
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> FlatFileSource
FlatFileSource derive(uploaddate = currentTimestamp(),
		ETLUser = $userName) ~> DerivedColumn
DerivedColumn sink(input(
		Rack as string,
		UploadDate as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		ETLUser as string,
		AuxTemp as double,
		RetTemp as double,
		VFDSpeed as double,
		DischargeAirStpt as double,
		DischargeAirTemp as double,
		UnitStatus as string,
		Date as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		ValvePos as double,
		Location as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		Rack,
		UploadDate = uploaddate,
		ETLUser,
		AuxTemp,
		RetTemp,
		VFDSpeed,
		DischargeAirStpt,
		DischargeAirTemp,
		UnitStatus,
		Date,
		ValvePos,
		Location),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
